$description: FYD design family motion tokens. Quiet by default: SUBTLE is the family default intensity. Reduced motion collapses everything to NONE. Semantics kept from motionTokens.ts; values in ms.

entrance.$description: ENUM FADE_RISE | REVEAL | SCALE, from MotionTokens

intensity.$description: ENUM NONE | SUBTLE | EXPRESSIVE. Default SUBTLE: quiet, quick, no theater.

stagger.$description: ENUM NONE | TIGHT | RELAXED; TIGHT = 50ms child offset
